notes: Native google-genai passthrough: request.json is the raw generateContent body a google-genai client sends to the gateway's /v1beta/models/{model}:{action} route; the adapter relays the upstream body untouched and the server bills from it with genaifmt.ExtractUsageMetadata / StreamUsageScanner (server/handlers_genai.go applyGenAIUsage). The flex service tier, requested with GenerateContentRequest.serviceTier and echoed in UsageMetadata.serviceTier (v1beta discovery; enum unspecified/standard/flex/priority). Not recordable until the drift job's key has access to the flex tier.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap G25: the service tier is not read, so a flex (discounted) or priority (premium) request is priced at the standard rate
